units.speaker: Anna
units.text: That's the walk. What have we done?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: About two kilometers, in six stops.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: A riverside gateway from the 1200s.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: A square with a fountain and a rebuilt town hall.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: A cathedral with a lantern that was meant to be temporary.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: A lane to a printing house with the oldest presses in the world.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And the home of a painter.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: What's the theme?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: That Antwerp is a city made by a river.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It got rich when the river opened, it suffered when the river closed, and it came back when the river did.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And the hand?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The hand is the joke it tells about itself.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Final tally.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Four, according to you.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Four, according to me. Which means I won, and you owe me a drink.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: I'm paying for champagne?

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: You said it, not me.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Back to the ship now. From the Rubens House, it's an easy walk back toward the river.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Head west along the shopping street, then down to the water.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Give yourself 20 minutes or more, and keep a map open.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And if you still have energy?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: If you want the whole story of the city before tonight, play Antwerp in 15 Minutes.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It covers the history in short.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Thank you for walking with us.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Safe travels, and enjoy your drink.
